scope: Real AOSP7.1.2_r6 unbundled VortexHome APK build only; no BSP/system/ramdisk/boot image or hardware validation.

sdk.scope: 22 individually fetched files, exact Git blob IDs verified, not a complete repository checkout

build.root_makefile: Exact copy of build/core/root.mk as required by the official r6 manifest copyfile rule.

host_compatibility.python2: Debian archive2.7.18 packages extracted task-locally; only wrapper selects it; no system package state changed.

acp.reason: Official r6 prebuilt i386 executable failed Exec format error on this host.
acp.source: Unmodified build r6 tools/acp/acp.c and libs/host/CopyFile.c
acp.warnings: Two pre-existing unused-variable warnings in acp.c remain visible; no source or diagnostic suppression applied.
acp.copy_check: Actual acp -fp copies official root.mk byte-identically.

zipalign.reason: Official r6 zipalign prebuilt is i386; use already installed real x86_64 Android SDK tool through a make variable override.

host_compatibility.jack_configuration: Final recipe directs CLIENT_SETTING and JACK_HOME to task-local paths. The first successful run initialized the default ~/.jack-settings; Jack server was disabled in every build.

artifact.signing_identity: Public AOSP platform TEST certificate from the pinned build tree, not a production key or the TVBox platform identity.

limits: The generic AOSP ARM product selects app build rules only. It does not establish Rockchip platform, kernel/HAL compatibility, mount layout, loader/DDR/trust, ramdisk, Android system image or boot.

The native legacy AOSP build rules and Jack/API25 were used. acp was compiled natively from unchanged r6 sources and zipalign33.0.2 was an explicit host compatibility override; this is not a pristine all-r6 host-prebuilt build.
No Android.mk source outside the Vortex module was changed, and no generated stub or dependency anchor was fabricated.
APK optimization/signing differs from the Gradle debug build; no emulator or physical runtime validation was performed for this AOSP-built artifact.
Public platform test signing does not grant this APK the production device platform identity.
No GitHub Actions, hardware operation, flash, environment configuration change or new board-information request was used.
